startUrl.title: Website URL
startUrl.description: Home page (or any page) of the website to audit, e.g. https://example.com. Only pages on the same hostname are crawled.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to audit. You pay per audited page, so this also caps the cost of a run.

checkExternalLinks.title: Check external links
checkExternalLinks.description: Also check up to 300 outbound links for 404s (slower).

generateLlmsTxt.title: Generate llms.txt draft
generateLlmsTxt.description: Build a ready-to-publish llms.txt file from the crawled pages (saved as the "llms.txt" record in the key-value store).

language.title: Report language
language.description: Language of the issue texts and the HTML report.
